title: Ferrous bisglycinate powder - Ingredients Supply
abstract:
## Description  
Main Efficacy  
1\. Treatment of Iron Deficiency Anemia (Core Application)  
Anemia in Pregnant Women: A recent systematic review and meta-analysis (17 RCTs) in 2026 showed that ferrous diglycinate significantly increased hemoglobin levels in pregnant women compared to other iron salts such as ferrous sulfate, ferrous fumarate, and ferric carbonyl, with a 64% reduction in the risk of gastrointestinal adverse events.  
Iron Deficiency in Children: Multiple studies have shown that ferrous diglycinate effectively increases hemoglobin and ferritin levels in children with good tolerability.  
Faster Onset of Action: Pregnant women using ferrous diglycinate reach target hemoglobin levels 3-4 weeks faster than with traditional iron supplements.  
2\. Prevention of Anemia During Pregnancy and Postpartum  
Postpartum Recovery: Postpartum and lactating women have increased iron requirements. The mild nature of ferrous diglycinate makes it a more practical choice, avoiding discontinuation due to gastrointestinal discomfort.  
3\. Improvement of Cognition and Physical Performance  
Cognitive Function: Iron deficiency affects cognitive abilities, attention, and learning abilities in children and adults. Correcting iron deficiency can improve these functions. Relieving fatigue: Iron deficiency in adults can lead to fatigue and decreased work capacity; supplementation can significantly improve energy and work efficiency.
